item.title: Riders Sign Former Rams Running Back Darrell Henderson Jr.
item.description: The Saskatchewan Roughriders have signed American running back Darrell Henderson Jr. Henderson Jr. was selected in the third round (70th overall) of the 2019 NFL Draft. item.description: The Saskatchewan Roughriders have signed American defensive back James Burgess Jr. Burgess Jr. (6’3-190) signed with the NFL’s New England Patriots as an undrafted free agent in 2025.
